digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure — bare repository fixture lifecycle
propositions: A test fixture bare repository created with `git init --bare` spawns detached `git maintenance run` processes on push that outlive the push command, leaving them concurrent with subsequent `copytree` operations

The concurrent maintenance process repacks loose objects and prunes fanout directories in `objects/`, causing `copytree` to encounter `FileNotFoundError` on paths that existed at walk start but were deleted mid-traversal
Filtering `*.lock` files from the copy does not resolve the issue because the race extends to entire directory trees, not just lock files
Pinning `receive.autogc=false`, `gc.autoDetach=false`, and `maintenance.autoDetach=false` on the fixture remote before any push eliminates the detached background process, making the race impossible
A new guard test asserts the absence of detached maintenance processes via `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` trace inspection with a `receive-pack` positive control to prevent vacuous passing
Both mutation checks (neutralizing pins and seeding repoint defect) were observed RED then GREEN, confirming the fix removes the race structurally rather than narrowing a timing window
